content.short: Babylon Protocol enables native Bitcoin staking, allowing BTC holders to secure PoS networks without bridging assets.
content.description: Babylon Protocol is a security-sharing protocol that introduces native staking to the Bitcoin network. It allows Bitcoin holders to provide economic security to Proof-of-Stake (PoS) blockchains directly from the Bitcoin mainnet without needing to "wrap" or bridge their BTC. This non-custodial approach ensures that stakers maintain control of their private keys while assets are held in time-locked vaults. The protocol uses a slashing mechanism to penalize malicious validators, ensuring the integrity of secured networks. By enabling Bitcoin to earn yield and provide security for the blockchain ecosystem, Babylon unlocks new utility for BTC holders and integrates Bitcoin into DeFi.
